{
  "version": "branchlab.contract.v1",
  "task_id": "15",
  "operation": "update_reservation_flights",
  "authorization": [
    "authenticated_user",
    "explicit_user_confirmation",
    "payment_method_owned_by_user"
  ],
  "hard_predicates": [
    "reservation_exists",
    "reservation_owned_by_user",
    "reservation_active",
    "origin_unchanged",
    "destination_unchanged",
    "trip_type_unchanged",
    "no_segment_flown",
    "target_flight_available",
    "seats_sufficient",
    "cabin_consistent",
    "passenger_count_unchanged",
    "payment_method_valid",
    "refund_destination_unchanged"
  ],
  "semantic_dependencies": [
    "reservation.M05KNL.origin",
    "reservation.M05KNL.destination",
    "reservation.M05KNL.trip_type",
    "reservation.M05KNL.cabin",
    "reservation.M05KNL.flights",
    "reservation.M05KNL.passengers",
    "reservation.M05KNL.payment_history",
    "user.aarav_garcia_1177.payment_methods",
    "flight.HAT110.available_seats.economy",
    "flight.HAT172.available_seats.economy"
  ],
  "tolerated_changes": [
    "price_decrease_within_user_limit"
  ],
  "write_effects": [
    "reservation.M05KNL.flights := [HAT110 ATL->LGA 2024-05-24 economy, HAT172 LGA->PHL 2024-05-24 economy]",
    "reservation.M05KNL.cabin := economy",
    "reservation.M05KNL.payment_history := refund_difference_to_original_payment_method"
  ],
  "source_evidence": [
    "User provided user id aarav_garcia_1177 and reservation M05KNL was located.",
    "User explicitly confirmed the 2024-05-24 itinerary HAT110 ATL->LGA and HAT172 LGA->PHL in Economy, total $207.",
    "Policy: modifications must keep the same origin, destination, and trip type; EWR destination change denied.",
    "Policy: if flights are changed, a single gift card or credit card already in the user profile must be used for payment or refund.",
    "User requested refund to original payment method if possible, otherwise asked to be informed before using gift card."
  ]
}
